name: minlopro-skill-library
description: Minlopro's shared Claude skill library, organized by department and discipline. Each skill is published as its own plugin.

plugins.name: data-migration-runbook
plugins.description: Plan and execute a Salesforce data migration or transformation the safe, repeatable way: profile, map, transform, load, validate, reconcile.

plugins.name: browser-qa
plugins.description: Drive a real Chrome browser (chrome-devtools MCP) to QA a web app's UI: reproduce bugs, exercise flows, read console/network, and cross-check the data layer.

plugins.name: agentforce-agent-builder
plugins.description: Build, edit, debug, and ship a Salesforce Agentforce agent the source-first way (Agent Script .agent bundle + Apex invocables).

plugins.name: minlopro-salesforce-project-setup
plugins.description: Stand up a complete agentic Salesforce delivery project from scratch: install the toolchain, authenticate the orgs and GitHub, scaffold an SFDX repo with the standard CLAUDE.md memory and a production-deploy guardrail hook, then hand off to the per-epic delivery loop.

plugins.name: minlopro-devhub-setup
plugins.description: Connect the Salesforce CLI to Minlopro production as a Dev Hub only, check scratch-org access and the firm's shared limits, and create scratch orgs with production guardrails.

plugins.name: apex-coding-standard
plugins.description: Enforce and apply Salesforce Apex coding standards when reviewing or writing Apex (triggers, handlers, SOQL, DML, test classes).

plugins.name: apex-test-authoring
plugins.description: Write meaningful Salesforce Apex test classes with real assertions and realistic data, not coverage padding.

plugins.name: deployment-workbook
plugins.description: Enforce the sprint-by-sprint deployment workbook format and the commit convention that accompanies each deploy log.

plugins.name: design-doc-standard
plugins.description: Enforce standards for structural project docs: design docs, dev/test plans, security matrices, ERDs, gap analyses, and orientation files.

plugins.name: flow-coding-standard
plugins.description: Enforce Salesforce Flow best practices: reliable, bulk-safe, maintainable Flows, and knowing when a Flow is the wrong tool.

plugins.name: lwc-coding-standard
plugins.description: Enforce and apply Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) coding standards when reviewing or writing LWC.

plugins.name: product-library-sanitize
plugins.description: Strip client details out of Salesforce metadata and package it as a reusable, generic Minlopro product-library asset.

plugins.name: product-library-search
plugins.description: Find reusable, client-free Salesforce assets in the Minlopro product library before building anything new.

plugins.name: proto-academy-authoring
plugins.description: Author Proto Academy (internal LMS) content directly in the live Salesforce org through the Create/Edit/Read MCP connection, as a content creator: permission-gated, no-delete record writes, evidence + manager-approval trainings, draft-and-confirm.
